BackStage Vet, hosted by Dr. Kathy, is where veterinary expertise meets engaging storytelling. As a seasoned veterinarian with an advanced degree in canine and feline practice and two decades of experience with all types of pets—Dr. Kathy blends science, curiosity, and communication to deliver insights in her signature 'Edutainment' style.

Renowned by her clients as an unparalleled medical detective, she combines her scientific knowledge and stage presence honed during her previous career as a musician / entertainer. This unique blend makes her content not only informative but also highly engaging and memorable.

While most medical topics are explored in the BackStage Vet studio, others take viewers on adventures around the world. Whether you're a new or experienced pet parent facing a medical challenge or simply curious about general pet topics, BackStage Vet is your go-to channel for expert advice, fascinating insights, and a deeper understanding of pets.
#backstagevet #doctorkathy
